about: High bar flight styles for the WG special repetition rule (WG MAG 2025 §15.2.2.5 c, MAG-NL-1 p. 6): at most two flight elements of each style count. Planner-owned (the WG Code names the styles but lists no elements): our reading of the WG EG II rows, for Nate to check. Advanced only (Nate, 2026-10-20). Skills not listed have no style limit. Built into js/data/wg-mag-rules.js by tools/build_data.py.

unstyled.WG-HB-II-26: Voronin (back uprise, pike-over ½ turn): a Markelov-like hecht from back uprise, left without a style
unstyled.WG-HB-II-32: back uprise, rear vault ¼ turn: left without a style
